question.text: An asset class is BEST defined as:

answer.text: A group of securities with similar characteristics and risk-return profile
Any security held in a demat account
A type of mutual fund scheme

explanation.text: The Logic: Asset class = securities sharing characteristics, attributes, and risk-return behavior. The Trap: A single share or scheme is an instrument, not an asset class. Cross-Exam Context: Consistent with CFA and NISM XV (Research Analyst) definitions. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Distinguish asset classes (equity/debt/real/alt/cash) from sub-classes (large cap/mid/small).
